senses.gloss:
हैम 1. हैम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. हेमन्),
wintry, brumal, cold, frigid, freezing; (अम्), n. hoar-
frost, dew.

हैम 2. हैम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. हेमन्),
golden, made of gold; of a golden yellow colour;
(अस्), m. epithet of Śiva; the plant Gentiana Che-
rayta; (आ or ई), f. yellow jasmine; (अम्), n. the
lexicon of Hema-candra.
—हैम-कोष, अस्, m.
Hema-candra's lexicon.
—हैम-चित्र-समुत्सेध,
अस्, आ, अम्, enchased with golden pictures.
—हैम-
मुद्रा or हैम-मुद्रिका, f. a golden coin.
—है-
ममुद्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having or possessing a golden
coin.
—हैम-वल्कल, अस्, आ, अम्, having bark
garments set with gold, clothed in gold.
—हैमा-
नेकार्थ (˚म-अन्˚), N. of a lexicon.
—हैमी-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become golden, turned into gold.

1. हैमन, अस्, ई, अम्, winterly, cold; growing
in winter, suitable to winter; (अस्), m. the month
Mārgaśīrṣa (= November-December); a kind of
rice which grows in winter, = षष्टिक; (अस्, अम्),
m. n. winter, the cold season, wintry weather.
2. हैमन, अस्, ई, अम्, golden, made of gold.

हैमन्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, wintry, cold, growing
in winter; (अम्), n. a kind of rice, (see हैमन
above.)

हैमल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. हिमल), winter,
the cold season.

हैमवत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. हिम-वत्), snowy,
covered with snow; flowing from the snowy moun-
tain; bred in or belonging to the Himālaya moun-
tains; (अस्), m. a sort of poison; (ई), f. epithet of
the goddess Pārvatī; the river Ganges (which rises
in the Himālaya mountains); N. of a wife of Viśvā-
mitra; a kind of drug or perfume (= रेणुका); a
kind of white orris root; common flax (= अतसी);
the plant Svarṇa-kṣīrī; a kind of myrobalan (=
हरीतकी); the tawny grape, (in some of these last
senses probably to be connected with 2. हैम
below); (अम्), n. Bhārata-varṣa or India.
—है-
मवत-वर्ष, अम्, n. India.
